description: Read the spend policies your workspace's buyer agents spend under (the most per purchase, a daily cap in UTC days, when a person approves first, which sellers and categories), the defaults a save fills in, and what today's reservations hold. An agent key sees its own policy and the workspace default. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: Optional: also say which policy governs this agent.

name: get_spend_policy
